summary: Defines continuous delivery as frequent updates with zero downtime and introduces the lamp_haproxy example playbook (roles, templates, group vars, rolling upgrades) that deploys Apache, PHP, MySQL, Nagios and HAProxy on CentOS.
questions: Can Ansible do zero-downtime continuous delivery?
Is there an example Ansible project for rolling upgrades of a web stack?
What does the lamp_haproxy example deploy?

answer_card.title: Continuous delivery with Ansible
answer_card.answer_md: Continuous delivery means shipping updates frequently (some users deploy hourly or on every approved change), which needs zero-downtime updates. The guide uses the **lamp_haproxy** example (roles, templates, group variables, and an orchestration playbook for rolling upgrades), which deploys Apache, PHP, MySQL, Nagios and HAProxy to CentOS servers.
